description: What the insight engine should do with each gold scene of gold.json. `insight`: at least one insight backed by a verified text; `abstain`: a clarification question or no insight (abstaining is the correct result). `hoped`: texts an editor would expect among the evidence (the learning path's anchors and the rain example of v2 §29); missing them is reported, it is not a failure, since the corpus holds other good answers.

scenes.why: A still phone does not mean reading or spreading news (masar §13.4): its use must be asked.
Hands hold a phone showing an article: verifying news before passing it on.
A market of fruit and vegetables: provision, honest trade.
A person looks at a kitten by a bowl: mercy to animals, without claiming feeding.
Many hands share a meal: blessing of shared food, moderation.
Open books by a window: seeking knowledge, without claiming that someone reads.
An empty room with a screen: time and attention, as a reminder at most.
Rain over cracked earth: the rain example of v2 §29.
An old tree on a slope: plants and fruit as signs, gratitude.
The Milky Way over dunes: reflection on creation.
Digital art of a lake and two moons: a thematic reminder at most, never a claim about a real sky.
A geometric medallion with no letters: no honest link to a text.
A seedling under rain: reviving the earth, growth.
A glass of water on a desk: water as a blessing; it is not alcohol.
Wine on a bar table: the image is never shown back nor stored, the legal meaning is shown with its verified text (v2 §6).
